knowledge_units.title: Spatial Clustering Analysis
knowledge_units.summary:
This lecture introduces spatial clustering analysis in GIS. Students should understand how clusters, hot spots, and spatial patterns can be detected from geographic data. Hot spot analysis identifies statistically significant spatial concentrations. It is often discussed together with spatial autocorrelation, Getis-Ord statistics, and interpretation of mapped results.

知识库补充：Emerging Hot Spot Analysis • Uses the Conceptualization of Spatial Relationships values you provide to calculate the Getis-Ord Gi* statistic (Hot Spot Analysis) for each bin. • Once the space-time hot spot analysis completes, each bin in the input NetCDF cube has an associated z-score, p-value, and hot spot bin classification added to it. • Next, these hot and cold spot trends are evaluated using the Mann-Kendall trend test. • With the resultant trend z-score and p-value for each location with data, and with the hot spot z-score and p-value for each bin, the Emerging Hot Spot Analysis tool categorizes each study area location as follows: Emer
